title: Hauler Manifest (v1)
description: A single hauler content manifest document. Multi-document YAML files contain one of these per document.

apiVersion.description: API group and version of the content or collection

metadata.description: Standard object metadata. Only name and annotations are used by hauler.

name.description: Name of this document, used in log output

annotations.description: Document-wide defaults. Values must be strings, so booleans need quoting (for example "true").

hauler.dev/store.description: Target store directory for this document

hauler.dev/key.description: Default cosign public key path for every image in this document

hauler.dev/registry.description: Default registry prefix for unqualified image names

hauler.dev/use-tlog-verify.description: Verify the transparency log during signature verification

hauler.dev/certificate-identity-regexp.description: Expected cosign certificate identity, as a regular expression

hauler.dev/certificate-oidc-issuer-regex.description: Expected cosign OIDC issuer, as a regular expression

hauler.dev/certificate-github-workflow-r.description: Expected GitHub workflow repository in the cosign certificate

hauler.dev/ca-file.description: CA bundle path used for remote fetches

images.description: Images to add to the store

name.description: Full image location, referenced by tag or digest

key.description: Path to the cosign public key used to verify image signatures

use-tlog-verify.description: Verify the transparency log during signature verification

certificate-identity-regexp.description: Expected cosign certificate identity, as a regular expression

certificate-oidc-issuer-regexp.description: Expected cosign OIDC issuer, as a regular expression

certificate-github-workflow-repository.description: Expected GitHub workflow repository in the cosign certificate

platform.description: Platform to pull, for example linux/amd64. All platforms are pulled when unset.

rewrite.description: Rewrite rule applied to the image reference

exclude-extras.description: Skip signatures, attestations and SBOMs for this image

local.description: Read the image from the local container runtime instead of a registry

ca-file.description: CA bundle path. The system bundle is used when unset.

insecure-skip-tls-verify.description: Skip TLS verification for this image

charts.description: Helm charts to add to the store

name.description: Chart name, an oci:// reference, or a local .tgz filename

repoURL.description: Chart repository URL, or a local directory holding the .tgz. Omit for an oci:// chart name.

version.description: Chart version. The latest version is used when unset.

rewrite.description: Rewrite rule applied to the chart reference

valuesFiles.description: Local values files used when resolving chart images and dependencies

platform.description: Platform used when pulling images discovered in the chart

add-images.description: Also add the images referenced by the chart

exclude-extras.description: Skip signatures, attestations and SBOMs for discovered images

keyring.description: Keyring path used when verify is set

usernameEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the repository username. HTTP repos only; use `hauler login` for OCI registries. Never put the raw value here.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the repository password. Never put the raw value here.

passCredentialsAll.description: Pass credentials to all domains, not just the chart repository

insecureSkipTLSVerify.description: Skip TLS verification for this chart

plainHTTP.description: Use plain HTTP instead of HTTPS

files.description: Files to add to the store

path.description: Local path or remote URL of the file contents. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's own directory.

name.description: Overrides the name derived from path

ca-file.description: CA bundle path for remote files. The system bundle is used when unset.

insecure-skip-tls-verify.description: Skip TLS verification for remote files

directories.description: Local directories to add to the store

path.description: Local path to the directory. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's own directory.

name.description: Overrides the name derived from path

git.description: Git repositories to add to the store

path.description: Local repository path, resolved against the manifest's own directory when relative, or a remote clone URL

name.description: Overrides the name derived from path

usernameEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the username. Never put the raw value here.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the password or token. Never put the raw value here.

sshKey.description: Path to the SSH private key used for cloning

insecureSkipTLSVerify.description: Skip TLS verification for this repository
